description: A dark purple oil-style painting of a stage in thick purple haze. A purple motorcycle sits left of an upright piano, with a ruffled sequined purple jacket draped over the stool. A rain-streaked window with blurred city lights is behind. Mic stands, cables and amplifiers fill the edges; the word 'Marshall' is legibly painted on the left amp. Fills the image edge to edge, no frame, nothing graphic.
reason: The brand name 'Marshall' is legibly painted on the amplifier at the left edge. Repaint the amps without lettering. The rest matches the card.
